params.blurb: {{sbc|Innate:}} {{cis|Rell}} {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} equal to a percentage of her {{as|'''total''' armor}} and {{as|'''total''' magic resistance}}.
params.blurb2: '''Rell's''' basic attacks and abilities apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Break The Mold'' to enemies hit for a few seconds. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}} and increases '''Rell's''' {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resist}}}} by the same amount.
params.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rell's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} deal {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} {{tip|on-hit}} equal to the sum of {{as|5% of her '''total''' armor}} and {{as|5% of her '''total''' magic resistance}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Rell's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} and {{tip|abilities}} against non-{{tip|minions}} apply a {{tip|stack}} of ''Break The Mold'' for 5 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits and stacking up to 5 times. Each stack reduces the target's {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}} by 3% for a maximum of 15% reduction.
params.description3: '''Rell''' gains {{as|'''bonus''' armor}} and {{as|'''bonus''' magic resistance}} equal to the sum of resistances reduced from all afflicted enemies.
params.description4: ''Break the Mold'' will reduce the target's {{as|armor}} and {{as|magic resistance}} by a minimum of {{pp|1.5 + (3-1.5)/17*(x-1) for 20}}.
params.notes:
* The attacks do not affect [[structures]].
* The first stack of ''Break the Mold'' that is applied to a target will snapshot the targets current {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}}. All subsequent stacks will reduce the targets resistances based on the snapshotted amount, even if the target's total resistances change. This snapshot lasts until the debuff expires.
** For example, applying a stack of ''Break the Mold'' to a champion with 100 {{sti|ar|{{as|armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|magic resistance}}}} will reduce their resistance by 3 and grant '''Rell''' the lost stats. If their resistances are then boosted to 500 before another stack is applied, the subsequent stack will only reduce their resistance by a further 3 despite 3% of 500 being 15.
** Another example, when a target has temporarily gained increased resistances before '''Rell''' applies the first stack of ''Break the Mold'' then the snapshot of the target's stats will be of the increased amount. This can result in targets losing significantly more resistances after the duration of the increase ends, for as long as the stacks don't fall off. 
** If a target has 100 base resistances, and they are increased to 500 temporarily before ''Break the Mold'' is applied, then the target will lose a total of 15 resistances, up to a total of 75 resistances at 5 stacks, and when the target's resistance buff ends they would only have 25 remaining.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rell}} thrusts her lance in the target direction that destroys damage {{tip|shield|shields}} of enemies hit before dealing {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}}.
params.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' thrusts her lance in the target direction, {{tip|lunge|lunging}} forward 100 units and destroying the damage-mitigating {{tip|shield|shields}} of all enemies hit (excluding the shields of {{tip|monsters}}) before dealing them {{as|magic damage}} and {{tip|stun|stunning}} them for {{fd|0.65}} seconds.
params.description2: '''''Rell''' will not {{tip|lunge}} forward after the cast time if she was {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} during it. She is also {{tip|lockout|unable to act}} for {{fd|0.35}} seconds after the cast time.''

params.description: {{sbc|Passive - Mounted Alacrity:}} While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she gains {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Dismounted}} and {{tip|dash|leaps}} to the target location over the cast time, granting herself a {{tip|shield}} that lasts until destroyed or casting ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}''. Upon arrival, she deals {{as|magic damage}} to nearby enemies, {{tip|stun|stuns}} them for {{fd|0.8}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|knocks them up}} for {{fd|0.4}} seconds. She will continue {{tip|dash|sliding}} forward another 320 units over {{tt|{{fd|0.5}} seconds|Estimated}}, though not through terrain, affecting further enemies along her path.

params.description3: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}''. Upon completing a {{si|Recall}} channel or respawning, '''Rell''' will automatically revert to {{sbc|Mounted}} form without casting the ability and reset ''{{ais|Ferromancy: Mount Up|Rell}}'' {{sti|cooldown}}.
params.description4: ''This ability can be cast only while Rell is {{sbc|Mounted}}. '''Rell''' can cast {{ai|Magnet Storm|Rell}} during the dash, and is considered to be dismounted at the start of the cast time.''
params.notes:
* ''Mounted Alacrity'' grants 15 {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} if the ability has not been learned (rank 0).
* '''Rell''' {{tip|dash|slides}} between 250 and 350 units in testing, depending on how far the spell was targeted. It is not known where this is intended.
* If '''Rell''' dashes before a wall on the map, the slide will cover a shorter distance to the terrain over the same time, moving slower.
** {{pending for test}} Interaction with player-made walls.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Passive:}} While {{ci|Rell}} is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she gains {{sti|ar|{{as|'''bonus''' armor}}}} and {{sti|mr|{{as|'''bonus''' magic resist}}}}.
params.blurb2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Mounted}} and gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for a short time, increased while moving towards enemy {{tip|champions}}.
params.blurb3: During this time, '''Rell's''' next basic attack will gain {{sti|range|'''bonus''' attack range}} and causes her to {{tip|dash|charge}} to the target, dealing {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}} before briefly {{tip|stun|stunning}} and {{tip|airborne|flinging}} them over.
params.blurb4: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Crash Down|Rell}}''.
params.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}, she gains {{sti|{{as|15% '''bonus''' armor}}}}, {{sti|{{as|15% '''bonus''' magic resistance}}}}, {{sti|{{as|20% '''bonus''' attack speed}}}}, and {{sti|75 '''bonus''' attack range}}.
params.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Rell''' becomes {{sbc|Mounted}}, gaining {{sti|ms|{{as|30% '''bonus''' movement speed}}}} decaying over 2 seconds and empowering her next basic attack within {{fd|3.5}} seconds to have a {{fd|0.2}}-second cast time, gain {{sti|100 '''bonus''' attack range}} and {{as|40% '''bonus''' attack speed}}, and cause her to {{tip|dash|charge}} at the target's location. Upon arrival or collision of the charge, her basic attack deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, {{tip|stun|stuns}} the target for {{fd|0.6}} seconds, and {{tip|airborne|flings}} them 150 units over herself, though not through terrain, over {{fd|0.4}} seconds.
params.description3: While '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Mounted}}, she can cast ''{{ai|Ferromancy: Crash Down|Rell}}''.
params.description4: ''Ferromancy: Mount Up {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Rell's''' basic attack timer. This ability can be cast only while '''Rell''' is {{sbc|Dismounted}}.''
params.notes:
* '''Rell''' will always respawn and start the game as mounted.
* The basic attack reset is not considered one for {{ri|Hail of Blades}}.
* '''Rell''' can use the empowered attack even while {{tip|ground|grounded}} or {{tip|root|rooted}}.
* The {{tip|dash}} can be {{tip|knockdown|knocked down}} but the attack's effects will still be applied.
* {{tip|Displacement immunity}} will not resist the application of the {{tip|stun}}.
* If the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, {{tip|death|dies}}, or is too far away or no longer in {{tip|sight}} during the empowered attack's cast time, it is cancelled but not consumed.

params.description2: Additionally, '''Rell's''' next {{tip|basic attack}} or ''{{ai|Shattering Strike|Rell}}'' within 5 seconds creates an explosion around {{tt|the target|See Notes}} that deals {{as|'''bonus''' magic damage}}, capped at {{pp|150 + (300-150)/17*(x-1) for 20}} against {{tip|monsters}} and {{tip|structures}}.

params.blurb: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Rell}} erupts in magnetic fury, {{tip|airborne|pulling}} nearby enemies inward. She then emits a {{tip|Kinematics|Kinematic}} field that continually deals {{as|magic damage}} over a short time.

params.inner radius: {{tip|cr|icononly = true}} {{tt|225|Pulls target into at least this radius, continuous kinetics does not affect targets already in this radius}}
params.speed: {{tt|300|Kinematic attraction speed, in units per second}}
params.notes:
{{Effect at cast time end}}
* ''Magnet Storm'' will '''not''' drag units that are:
** {{tip|Dash|Dashing}}.
** Being displaced (e.g. by {{tip|airborne}} effects)
** {{tip|Attach|Attached}}.
** {{tip|Displacement immune|Displacement immune}}.
** {{tip|cc-immune|Immune to crowd control}}.
* {{tip|Spell shield}} will block the initial {{tip|airborne|pull}} but not the dragging effect.
* ''Magnet Storm'' cannot be cast again while it is active.
